name: There's No Santa
description:
Enjoy the season with There's no Santa, a delightful hidden-object game with colorful locations and Christmas-related objects to discover. Search for Christmas-themed items in a cozy, cartoony world that’s perfect for casual gamers and puzzle enthusiasts alike. 

With three levels of difficulty, it offers great replayability. Combine this with 9 festive locations, 20 items to find, and a pool of 60 items random every play which makes it a never-ending Find and Seek game. Use the hint system and zoom feature to help locate tricky objects. 

Key Features:

9 festive locations 
3 levels of difficulty 
20 out of 60 items per game 
Hint system, zoom


Enjoy a festive hidden object adventure with There's no Santa!
